title: Frequency sorting in graded dispersive resonator arrays via volume-interaction matrices
summary: We study graded arrays of highly dispersive subwavelength resonators through their volume-potential matrix reduction. The reduction gives a finite-dimensional nonlinear resonance problem whose diagonal entries encode the local dispersive response and whose off-diagonal entries encode volume-mediated coupling between distinct resonators. We show that monotone material grading turns this matrix into an analytically controllable frequency sorter.
